The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft, headquartered in Germany, is the world’s leading applied research organization. The majority of the organization’s 29,000 employees are qualified scientists and engineers, who work with an annual research budget of 2.8 billion euros. Of this sum, 2.4 billion euros are generated through contract research.
As Fraunhofer IMM, we work in the fields of chemistry, energy and diagnostics. Our scientists perform the transfer from the scientific idea towards innovation. Thereby, we are able to improve the reliability and efficiency of compact material and energy conversion systems as well as of decentralized, mobile power supply units. We increase process reliability and availability of materials, measurement data and information for product, manufacturing and analytical issues, also in the field of diagnostics. We improve the reliability of process monitoring and increase the robustness of sensors. Our laboratory and pilot scale system solutions can straightly and consistently be transformed into production scale. It is our mission to act in a professional, quality-conscious, economical and sustainable way taking our expertise as a foundation.”

Small Robot Company is delivering Per Plant Farming to the world's largest food crops.
 
Using a suite of robots (called Tom, Dick and Harry) linked and controlled by an AI driven operating system (called Wilma), weprovide a near-real time view of each crop plant as it grows through the season, and then deliver precise, timely interventions to make that plant reach its full potential.
 
Tom lives on the farm, continuously gathering data on the plants and the environment.Wilma is the brains of the operation, converting Tom’s data into instructions for Dick and Harry.
This is per plant intelligence

Dick nurtures and protects the crop. He only treats the plants that need it.
Harry precisely plants the crop at exactly the right depth and spacing for the conditions, giving it the best chance of the highest yields.
This is per plant action.

Through this system, we aim to reduce inputs by 90%, and convert arable farming from emitting up to 3 tonnes/CO2e/Ha to sequestered up to 2tonnes/CO2e/Ha for the 4bn Ha or arable farmland in the world.

Our system is dependent on the most accurate global positioning capability, combined with layered data, from satellite level down to individual plant level.

entityName: AECSIC - Instituto de Astrofisica de Andalucia
entityDescription:
The IAA occupies a strong and unique position in astrophysics and space research in Spain, being the biggest centre for astrophysical research in the CSIC. Its multidisciplinarity and the experience in multi-range astronomy favour the existence of transversal synergetic projects. It is our declared goal to transform the IAA into one of the leading institutes in astrophysics and space science in Europe and to evolve its research and structure to a level where the IAA is placed at the pole position for the exploitation of the upcoming next generation of advanced, ground-breaking experiments.

IAA researchers are internationally recognized leaders in the remote and in situ studies of the planetary atmospheres and surfaces, as well as of minor bodies. Their expertise embrace laboratory experiments, instruments design, data acquisition, data analysis and theoretical modelling on multi-timescale changes and coupling in the Earth’s middle and upper atmosphere, on the martian atmosphere composition and escape to decipher water history on Mars, on the atmospheric composition of the icy giants, giant planets and of Titan, on the interior structure and rotational state of comet nuclei and asteroids, or the study of physical properties of TNOs using stellar occultations, or the scattering properties of relevant refractory material in planetary systems.This wide expertise has allowed the IAA researchers to be Co-PI or Co-I of the majority of ESA interplanetary missions in the last three decades. The eLightning ERC CONSOLIDATOR GRANT, devoted to decipher the origin and the behaviour of the lightning discharges in the upper atmosphere of the Earth is developed in the planetary atmospheres group. IAA researchers are involved in ground-breaking instrumental on polarimetric observations of the Sun to infer the origin and dynamics of its magnetic field.

IAA plays a leading role in the development of space-borne and ground-based instruments. This is a unique feature and strength of the IAA, unmatched by any Spanish institute, and only by very few international peers. Examples for recent IAA important contributions to instruments onboard successful interplanetary missions are GIADA and OSIRIS (ROSETTA), ImaX/Sunrise, BeLA/Bepi Colombo, NOMAD/Exomars, SO/PHI, JANUS and GaLA/JUICE in the near future, and CoCa, MANIaC, EnVisS and OPIC/Comet Interceptor in the future.

AlgoSource has over 25 years of experience in selection, cultivation, extraction and formulation of functional ingredients from microalgae.

Gisat provides a wide range of geoinformation services based on Earth Observation technology. It focuses on operational application of satellite mapping to monitor various aspects of our environment and development of dedicated web based platforms for geoinformation data analytics.
GISAT is a privately owned SME sized company. It is based in Prague, the capital of Czech Republic. Since 2008, the company has been ISO9001 & ISO14001 certified to guarantee the quality of provided services and responsibility in environmental impacts of its activities.
GISAT’s team has proven expertise in automated image analysis, GIS and statistical techniques driven by object-based (OBIA), artificial intelligence (machine & deep learning, neural networks), feature extraction and semi-automated approaches. Specialized operational automated cloud based processing chains for land use & land cover, agriculture crops & practices mapping and monitoring, ground subsidence & infrastructure deformation, flood mapping or vegetation evolution monitoring from various optical and radar sensors have been developed in frame of research or operational projects. Customized open source tools based on geospatial statistics and area frame sampling for land applications have been designed and implemented at the company. The company’s specialists use both COTS and open source tools to facilitate effective geo-spatial intelligence extraction from EO imagery.
GISAT is very successful in delivering interactive data2information web platforms solutions based on open source components. The company develops its own framework for the web analytical platforms aiming at interactive data exploration & analysis and dealing with synchronized interactive maps, charts, and tables. It allows users with no prior GIS experience to access, explore, visualize, analyse and share spatial data from a variety of sources in an interactive and customizable way.
